marlin_bay_dockworkers_union_local.name: Marlin Bay dockworkers' union local
marlin_bay_dockworkers_union_local.persona_brief:
You are Marlin Bay dockworkers' union local.
The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. The local is aware of the port automation memorandum and is considering whether to endorse it. There is internal disagreement: a rank-and-file caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month, which may influence but does not bind the local.

resolution.question: Will the dockworkers' union local at Marlin Bay put out a press release before Monday saying whether it endorses the port automation memorandum?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the local actually issued a press release before 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00 stating its endorsement or non-endorsement of the port automation memorandum. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
